title: Block-Wise Differentiable Sinkhorn Attention: Tail-Refinement Gradients with a Gap-Aware Dustbin Bridge
abstract: arXiv:2605.08123v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study long-context balanced entropic optimal transport (OT) attention on TPU hardware through a stopped-base, fixed-depth tail-refinement surrogate. After a stopped $T$-step Sinkhorn solve, we unroll a short refinement tail and differentiate that surrogate exactly. For the reported $R=2$ TPU path, the backward pass contains four staircase plan factors. We prove an exact one-reference-tile schedule: the $R=2$ score cotangent is a single reference plan tile times an explicit modifier field built from vector cotangents and dual differences. This yields block-wise cost $O((T+R)LW)$, $O(Ld)$ input storage, and $O(L)$ additional HBM usage for fixed head dimension $d$ and band width $W$ on the balanced fixed-support path. translated_title: 块级可微Sinkhorn注意力：具有间隙感知垃圾箱桥接的尾部精细化梯度
translated_abstract: 我们通过一种截断基底、固定深度的尾部精细化替代方法，研究TPU硬件上的长上下文平衡熵最优传输（OT）注意力。在执行停止的T步Sinkhorn求解之后，我们展开一个较短的精细化尾部，并对该替代方法进行精确微分。对于所报告的R=2 TPU路径，反向传播包含四个阶梯式传输计划因子。我们证明了一个精确的单参考瓦片调度：R=2得分的余切等于单个参考传输计划瓦片乘以一个由向量余切和对偶差构造的显式修正场。在平衡固定支撑路径上，对于固定的头维度d和带宽W，这带来了块级计算代价O((T+R)LW)、O(Ld)的输入存储以及仅O(L)的额外HBM内存占用。我们还将当前的dustbin_block路径形式化为增广支撑上的相同单位目标替代方法，从而使伴随调度能够提升至TPU运行中使用的单活跃垃圾箱路径；该桥接（摘要内容此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出块级可微Sinkhorn注意力方法，通过尾部精细化替代与间隙感知垃圾箱桥接，在TPU上实现了长上下文平衡熵最优传输注意力的精确且高效的反向传播，将块级计算代价降至O((T+R)LW)且仅需O(L)额外HBM内存。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes block-wise differentiable Sinkhorn attention that achieves exact and efficient backpropagation for long-context balanced entropic optimal transport attention on TPUs via a tail-refinement surrogate and a gap-aware dustbin bridge, reducing block-wise cost to O((T+R)LW) with only O(L) additional HBM memory.
